summary: Filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events, reporting that MultiSensor AI Holdings, Inc. was notified by Nasdaq on April 27, 2026, that it regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) and that the matter is closed. No specific deal terms, price, premium, or board recommendation are stated. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation event. No action or transaction is involved.
